title: 第10章 诡异古剑

content_zh:
“是你自己投怀送抱的！而且你那里那么小，还把自己打扮的这么花枝招展的，真是令人不齿呀！”
姜辰将自己的手放在鼻子前闻了一下，又一脸厌恶的在自己的衣服上使劲儿的擦了几下。
“我杀了你！”
姜婷儿疯了一样的冲了过来，手中的剑施展出碧水剑道，杀出一片又一片的碧水剑气。
只可惜，这些剑气在姜辰眼中，错漏百出。
姜辰随意还手，不时一掌拍在姜婷儿的身上。
不过，姜辰的手，根本就不客气，哪里舒服朝着哪里下手。
姜婷儿气疯了，不堪之下，竟是将剑往地上一扔，呜呜呜的哭了起来。
而姜峰，此时也双眼通红，艰难站起来之后，手持飞剑，同样施展碧水剑道，朝着姜辰疯狂杀来。
这次，姜峰甚至于动用了紫气境八重圆满的实力，再没有收敛。
不过对待姜峰，姜辰可不会客气。
姜峰冲来，姜辰随手就是一拳。
“噗——”
姜峰牙齿打落四五颗，倒飞而出，血流满面。
“轰！”
姜峰狠狠地摔在了地上。
“啊——”
姜峰感觉到无比的屈辱，再次冲上来。
“嘭！”
又是一拳，姜峰的另外半边脸高高肿起，一大口血在空中便已经无法忍住而喷出。

血中，还有数颗断裂的牙齿。
姜峰如死狗一样的趴在地上，身体动弹不得。
姜辰却在此时走了过去。
姜婷儿呆呆的看着这一幕，忽然打了个冷颤。
而姜辰，此时一脚直接踩在了姜峰的头上，将他的头，活活的踩到了地面那并不松软的黄土里。
“姜峰，你想侮辱我？我姜辰只是不愿意计较而已！你算什么东西？你有什么资格骂我？今次，我只是给你一个小小的教训，看在你之前动手也没下死手的份上，我饶你一贱命！再有下次，我废了你的丹田和武脉，挑断你的手筋脚筋，再斩断你的四肢和男人的命|根子，让你成为一个活死人！让你生不如死！”
姜辰将自己的脚狠狠的踩在姜峰的头上，并狠戾的说出这几句话。
之前的笑，和现在的冷血模样，完全如两个人一样。
可这样的姜辰，竟是让姜婷儿心中生出极大的恐惧之意。
便是之前被姜辰轻薄的愤怒，都压不下那种发自心灵的恐惧。
姜辰说完，冷冷的扫了姜婷儿一眼。
“啊——”
姜婷儿惊呼，倒退了几步，一下子摔倒在地上，俏脸直接变得苍白。
姜辰收回目光，又抬起脚，在姜峰的侧脸上狠狠蹂|躏了两脚，才转过身，朝着不远处的寒潭走去。
而这，自始至终，姜峰竟是再没有说一句话。
许久之后，姜婷儿才不时低声哭泣，并将姜峰扶起，小心翼翼的带着姜峰离开。
姜辰没有关注姜峰的事情。
姜峰，终究是姜家人，终究年轻。
欺负族人，毫无意义，姜辰也不觉得这么做有什么成就感。
但这不代表，他姜辰就可以随便被人欺辱。

以前，那便也罢了。
以后，他一定会有恩必还，有仇必报！
姜辰心中作出了这般的决定之后，心中的那份戾气才渐渐的平息了。
姜辰和过去的姜辰最大的不同，便是哪怕是三年的苟活和压迫，他心中的热血都并没有消退。
哪怕是病体残躯，哪怕是鹊巢鸠占，哪怕那个躯体各种废物，他都没有放弃那个躯体。
最终，他获得了这个躯体的掌控权，并融合了那个姜辰。
如今，那样的日子结束了！
如今，才一天过去，他便已经真正的崛起了。
姜辰深吸一口气，来到了寒潭边。
清冷的风簌簌的吹着，寒风扑面，寒潭的潭水平静得如一面镜子。
姜辰站在寒潭边，看着那寒潭许久，随后，他才在寒潭边选了一个干净的地方，盘坐了下来。
随后，姜辰从那乾坤戒指之中取出姜峰的两套衣服，直接的运功于手中，真气一震，那衣服就直接粉碎。
接着，姜辰再次拿出一套白色的儒衫来，这是全新的衣服，携带着淡淡的元气气息，乃是携带着简单的避尘阵法的灵衣。
而且，其防御效果，也比一般的丝绸、锦缎的衣服要好许多。
姜辰身体一震，真气溢出，身上立刻一片精光，随后他将这灵衣儒衫穿在了身上。
顿时，一股清凉的感觉油然而生，一种极为舒适贴切的感觉呈现了出来。
衣服原本还略微偏小，但是在穿上身之后，竟是自主的变大了几分，这让姜辰也很是满意。

content_en:
"It's you who threw yourself into my arms! And you're so small, yet you dress yourself up in such a flashy way. It's really disgusting!"
Jiang Chen put his hand in front of his nose and smelled it, then wiped it vigorously on his clothes with a look of disgust.
"I'll kill you!"
Jiang Ting'er rushed over like a madman, using the sword in her hand to display the blue water sword technique, firing out pieces of green water sword energy.
It's a pity that these sword energies are full of mistakes in Jiang Chen's eyes.
Jiang Chen fought back casually, slapping Jiang Ting'er on the body from time to time.
However, Jiang Chen's hands were not polite at all, and he would strike wherever he felt comfortable.
Jiang Ting'er was so angry that she threw the sword to the ground and started crying.
Jiang Feng's eyes were red at this time. After struggling to stand up, he held a flying sword and also used the blue water sword technique to kill Jiang Chen crazily.
This time, Jiang Feng even used the perfect strength of the eighth level of the Purple Qi Realm and never restrained himself.
However, Jiang Chen would not be polite to Jiang Feng.
Jiang Feng rushed towards him, and Jiang Chen casually punched him.
"Pfft——"
Four or five of Jiang Feng's teeth were knocked out and flew out, with blood all over his face.
"Boom!"
Jiang Feng fell hard to the ground.
"Ah——"
Jiang Feng felt extremely humiliated and rushed forward again.
"Bang!"
With another punch, the other half of Jiang Feng's face swelled up, and a large mouthful of blood spurted out in the air as he could no longer hold it back.
There were several broken teeth in the blood.
Jiang Feng lay on the ground like a dead dog, unable to move.
Jiang Chen walked over at this moment.
Jiang Ting'er stared at this scene blankly and suddenly shuddered.
As for Jiang Chen, he stepped directly on Jiang Feng's head, forcing his head into the soft loess on the ground.
"Jiang Feng, you want to insult me? I, Jiang Chen, just don't want to care! Who are you? What qualifications do you have to scold me? This time, I'm just giving you a small lesson. Seeing that you didn't kill me before, I will spare your life! Next time, I will destroy your Dantian and martial arts, pick off your tendons and hamstrings, and then cut off your limbs and the lifeblood of a man, making you a living dead! Let your life be worse than death!"
Jiang Chen stepped hard on Jiang Feng's head and said these words harshly.
The smile before and the cold-blooded look now are exactly the same.
But Jiang Chen like this actually made Jiang Ting'er feel great fear in her heart.
Even the anger at being treated lightly by Jiang Chen could not suppress the fear that came from the heart.
After Jiang Chen finished speaking, he glanced at Jiang Ting'er coldly.
"Ah——"
Jiang Ting'er exclaimed, took a few steps back, fell to the ground, and her pretty face turned pale.
Jiang Chen withdrew his gaze, raised his foot again, and ravaged the side of Jiang Feng's face twice before turning around and walking towards the cold pool not far away.
And from beginning to end, Jiang Feng actually didn't say a word.
After a long time, Jiang Ting'er cried softly from time to time, helped Jiang Feng up, and carefully took Jiang Feng away.
Jiang Chen didn't pay attention to Jiang Feng's affairs.
Jiang Feng is a member of the Jiang family after all, and he is young after all.
There was no point in bullying the clan members, and Jiang Chen didn't feel any sense of accomplishment in doing so.
But this doesn't mean that he, Jiang Chen, can be bullied casually.
In the past, that was fine.
From now on, he will definitely repay kindness and revenge!
After Jiang Chen made such a decision in his heart, the anger in his heart gradually subsided.
The biggest difference between Jiang Chen and Jiang Chen in the past is that even after three years of living in poverty and oppression, the passion in his heart has not faded.
Even if it was a sick and broken body, even if it was occupied by a magpie's nest, even if that body was all kinds of waste, he never gave up on that body.
Finally, he gained control of this body and merged with Jiang Chen.Now, those days are over!
Now, only one day has passed, and he has truly risen.
Jiang Chen took a deep breath and came to the edge of the cold pool.
The cool wind was blowing, the cold wind was blowing on my face, and the water of Hantan was as calm as a mirror.
Jiang Chen stood by the cold pool and looked at the cold pool for a long time. Then, he chose a clean place by the cold pool and sat down cross-legged.
Afterwards, Jiang Chen took out two sets of Jiang Feng's clothes from the Qiankun Ring, and directly put his kung fu into his hands. With a shock of his true energy, the clothes were shattered into pieces.
Then, Jiang Chen once again took out a set of white Confucian shirts. These were brand new clothes, carrying a faint breath of vitality. They were spiritual clothes that carried a simple dust-proof formation.
Moreover, its defensive effect is much better than ordinary silk and brocade clothes.
Jiang Chen's body was shaken, his true energy overflowed, and his body was immediately radiant. Then he put on this spiritual robe and Confucian shirt.
Suddenly, a cool feeling emerged spontaneously, and an extremely comfortable and appropriate feeling emerged.
The clothes were originally a little too small, but after putting them on, they actually became a bit bigger on their own, which made Jiang Chen very satisfied.
